evidence_status: post-hoc hardened reanalysis of an internally locked test with an interim look
historical_limitations: The prediction lock was timestamped locally and had no independent third-party custody.
The first surviving score path was created when 1797 of 1800 registered records existed; three records arrived later and the same path was overwritten with the final 1800-record score.
The surviving collector was created after the recorded collection and cannot prove which collector enforced the historical run.
The surviving evaluator was modified after the stored result; the exact evaluator bytes used for the historical score are unavailable.
This contract and hardened fail-closed implementation are retrospective audit artifacts and are not part of the original lock.
